title: Deformation of the shells: homotopy identities, integrality, mass and support bounds (Simon 6.5.1, (11)–(16), (20), (22)–(23))
statement: Deformation of the shells of a decomposed current (Simon Ch. 6, proof of 5.1, displays (11)–(16), (20), (22)–(23)). Let P, m ∈ ℕ and let push_k(F, X) ∈ 𝒟_k(ℝ^P), homot_k(F, G, X) ∈ 𝒟_{k+1}(ℝ^P) be operations (k ∈ ℕ, F, G : ℝ^P → ℝ^P, X ∈ 𝒟_k(ℝ^P), domain univ) satisfying (PF), the property that the conclusion of the frozen type of Submission.cmcdt_lipschitz_pushforward_homotopy asserts, for this P, of the operations push and homot it provides (the body after its ∃ push homot, taken verbatim as a hypothesis): calling X normal with compact support (NC) when spt X is compact, M(X) < ∞ and boundaryMassOn X univ < ∞ (= M(∂X) for k ≥ 1, 0 for k = 0), for all Λ ∈ ℝ≥0, all Λ-Lipschitz F, G, F', G' and all NC X, Y of degree k: (1) push_k(id, X) = X; (2) push_k(F, X − Y) = push_k(F, X) − push_k(F, Y) and homot_k(F, G, X − Y) = homot_k(F, G, X) − homot_k(F, G, Y); (3) if F = F' and G = G' on spt X then push_k(F, X) = push_k(F', X) and homot_k(F, G, X) = homot_k(F', G', X); (4) M(push_k(F, X)) ≤ Λ^k M(X), spt push_k(F, X) ⊆ F(spt X), M(homot_k(F, G, X)) ≤ δ(2Λ)^k M(X) whenever δ ∈ ℝ and |F(x) − G(x)| ≤ δ for x ∈ spt X, and spt homot_k(F, G, X) ⊆ {F(x) + t(G(x) − F(x)) : x ∈ spt X, t ∈ [0, 1]}; (5) for X ∈ 𝒟_{k+1}(ℝ^P) with compact support, M(X) < ∞, M(∂X) < ∞: ∂ push_{k+1}(F, X) = push_k(F, ∂X), push_{k+1}(G, X) − push_{k+1}(F, X) − homot_k(F, G, ∂X) = ∂ homot_{k+1}(F, G, X), and if X is integer multiplicity then push_{k+1}(F, X) and homot_{k+1}(F, G, X) are integer multiplicity; (6) for X ∈ 𝒟_0(ℝ^P) with compact support and finite mass, push_0(G, X) − push_0(F, X) = ∂ homot_0(F, G, X). Assume moreover (S-ii) every X ∈ 𝒟_m(ℝ^P) (domain univ) has closed support, and (S-iii) spt(A − B) ⊆ spt A ∪ spt B for all A, B ∈ 𝒟_m(ℝ^P) (these are conjuncts (ii) and (iii), in degree m, of the frozen type of Submission.cmcsd_support_calculus, taken as hypotheses). Let W_j ∈ 𝒟_{m+1}(ℝ^P), D_j, Z_j ∈ 𝒟_m(ℝ^P), φ_j : ℝ^P → ℝ^P, Λ_j ∈ ℝ≥0 (j ∈ ℕ), δ ∈ ℝ and L, A, A' ⊆ ℝ^P, and assume: ∂W_0 = D_0 − Z_0 and ∂W_{j+1} = D_{j+1} − (Z_{j+1} − Z_j) for all j; every W_j is integer multiplicity; spt W_j, spt D_j, spt Z_j are compact, M(W_j), M(∂W_j), M(D_j), M(Z_j) < ∞ and boundaryMassOn D_j ℝ^P, boundaryMassOn Z_j ℝ^P < ∞; φ_j is Λ_j-Lipschitz, 1 ≤ Λ_j and Λ_j ≤ Λ_{j+1}; φ_{j+1} = φ_j on spt Z_j; dist(φ_j(x), x) ≤ δ for x ∈ spt W_j ∪ spt D_j ∪ spt Z_j; φ_j(x) ∈ L for x ∈ spt W_j; spt W_j ⊆ A and spt D_j ⊆ A'. Write id := (x ↦ x) and V_j := push_{m+1}(φ_j, W_j), H_j := homot_{m+1}(φ_j, id, W_j) ∈ 𝒟_{m+2}(ℝ^P), Y_j := push_m(φ_j, D_j), E′_j := homot_m(φ_j, id, D_j), L′_j := push_m(φ_j, Z_j), K_j := homot_m(φ_j, id, Z_j). Then: (c1) W_0 − V_0 − (E′_0 − K_0) = ∂H_0; (c2) W_{j+1} − V_{j+1} − (E′_{j+1} − (K_{j+1} − K_j)) = ∂H_{j+1} for all j; (c3) ∂V_0 = Y_0 − L′_0; (c4) ∂V_{j+1} = Y_{j+1} − (L′_{j+1} − L′_j) for all j; (c5) V_j and H_j are integer multiplicity for all j; (c6) for all j, M(V_j) ≤ (2Λ_j)^{m+1}M(W_j), M(H_j) ≤ δ·((2Λ_j)^{m+1}M(W_j)), M(Y_j) ≤ (2Λ_j)^m M(D_j), M(E′_j) ≤ δ·((2Λ_j)^m M(D_j)), M(L′_j) ≤ (2Λ_j)^m M(Z_j) and M(K_j) ≤ δ·((2Λ_j)^m M(Z_j)) (in [0, ∞], δ read as ENNReal.ofReal δ); (c7) for all j, spt V_j ⊆ L ∩ cthickening(δ, A), spt H_j ⊆ cthickening(δ, A), spt Y_j ⊆ cthickening(δ, A') and spt E′_j ⊆ cthickening(δ, A') (Metric.cthickening). Conventions: ℝ^P = Euclid P (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin P)); for U ⊆ ℝ^P, 𝒟^k(U) = TestFormOn U k (smooth k-forms on ℝ^P whose compact tsupport lies in U) and 𝒟_k(U) = GeometricCurrentOn U k (SimonGMT Chapter06), X(ω) the value of X on ω; X − Y is the contract subtraction, (X − Y)(ω) = X(ω) − Y(ω) (definitional); ∂X = X.boundary, ∂X(η) = X(dη) (GeometricCurrentOn.boundary_apply, dη = exteriorDerivativeTestOn U k η, whose underlying form is exteriorDerivative η); currents are equal when their values agree (GeometricCurrentOn.ext). |α| = covectorEuclideanNorm α is the Euclidean coefficient norm of a covector. M_G(X) = X.massOn G ∈ [0, ∞] is the supremum of ENNReal.ofReal X(ω) over the ω ∈ 𝒟^k(U) with tsupport ω ⊆ G and |ω(x)| ≤ 1 for all x (such ω are admissible for M_G, massAdmissibleOn U k G); M(X) = X.mass = M_U(X); boundaryMassOn X G = M_G(∂X) if k ≥ 1 and 0 if k = 0. spt X = X.support (Simon 6.2.11) = U minus the zero region, the union of the open W with compact closure contained in U on which X vanishes (X(ω) = 0 whenever tsupport ω ⊆ W). IM = IsIntegerMultiplicity: X is represented by an IMRep R = (M, θ, ξ) of the contract, i.e. X(ω) = R.action ω = ∫_M θ⟨ω, ξ⟩ dHⁿ. Metric.cthickening δ E = {x : infEdist x E ≤ ENNReal.ofReal δ}; in a mass bound, a real factor δ is read as ENNReal.ofReal δ.
